name: dotsearch
description: 增强搜索引擎用户体验的 UserScript（支持 Bing / Google）

scripts.release:bing: node scripts/build-engine.mjs bing && node scripts/verify-artifacts.mjs bing && node scripts/verify-release.mjs bing
scripts.release:google: node scripts/build-engine.mjs google && node scripts/verify-artifacts.mjs google && node scripts/verify-release.mjs google
scripts.release:all: npm run release:bing && npm run release:google
scripts.verify:settings: node scripts/build-engine.mjs bing --dev && esbuild src/engines/bing.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.build/bing-unit.mjs --log-level=silent && node scripts/verify-settings.mjs
scripts.verify:google: node scripts/build-engine.mjs google --dev && esbuild src/engines/google.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.build/google-unit.mjs --log-level=silent && node scripts/verify-google.mjs
scripts.verify:all: node scripts/build.mjs --engine=all --dev && node scripts/verify-strip.mjs && node scripts/verify-strip.mjs --dark && node scripts/verify-live.mjs --document-start && npm run verify:google
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
